# Walter Blythe

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 c8 P26](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0026)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Walter  <sub>[v5 c17 P8](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Walter is considered the handsomest of the Ingleside children and does not resemble any known relative. He has straight black hair, finely modelled features, and splendid, dark gray eyes full of deep expression.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012), [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c4 P23](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0023)_

## Personality

Possessing a vivid imagination and a passionate love of beauty, Walter is sensitive, artistic, and deeply moved by nature and poetry. He avoids physical conflict and sports, preferring to spend time reading alone, though he has a strong dramatic sense and enjoys thrilling his companions with stories. Despite a natural aversion to violence and vulgarity, he possesses steady courage to stand up and fight for those he loves when they are insulted.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012), [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c8 P27](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0027), [v5 c17 P16](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0016), [v5 c17 P20](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0020)_

## Goals

- to become a poet  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)</sub>

## History

Walter grew up as one of the Ingleside children. At school, where he was misjudged as soft because he avoided fights and sports to read poetry, he commanded respect due to his unique, articulate way of speaking and even won a school prize for writing a poem. He spent time playing and reading with his siblings and the children from the manse in Rainbow Valley. While reading aloud myths to his friends one evening, he experienced a vivid presentiment of following the call of a mysterious piper away to sea. When Dan Reese insulted Faith Meredith and Walter's mother, Walter defended them by knocking Dan down and calmly agreeing to a fistfight after school.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c4 P24](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0024), [v5 c8 P12](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0012), [v5 c8 P23](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0023), [v5 c17 P12](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0012), [v5 c17 P16](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0016), [v5 c17 P18](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0018)_

> Some day, the Pied Piper will come over the hill up there and down Rainbow Valley, piping merrily and sweetly. And I will follow him—follow him down to the shore—down to the sea—away from you all.  <sub>[v5 c8 P23](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0023)</sub>
